task_card.concrete_object_and_question: The MAS edge form of Theorem B2 (iii): in the PR 2162 rank-3 decoder model (v lines with rational p(t), q(t) in Q^3, p(t).q(t) != 0; admissible 0/1 pairing B with unit diagonal and B_ts = 1 only where p(t).q(s) = 0; cost(B) = sum_j rank_F2 B[R_j, A_j] over the three coordinate supports), does cost(B) >= v - |H| - |F| + masE hold for every configuration and every admissible B, where masE is the maximum acyclic edge subset of the wild digraph W[F]? The printed proof of PR 2162 only yields the vertex form with masV (PR 2293 finding 4).

Fixed domain and seeds; finite results only.

actual_scope: Settle or advance the MAS edge form cost(B) >= v - |H| - |F| + masE of Theorem B2 (iii) (PR 2162): exact falsifier search smallest-instance-first over a declared domain of near-dense wild cores at v = 3..8, plus a written all-full-support v <= 4 proposition and the complete-pair impossibility lemma behind it.
scope_change_reason: Drawn cards formal-interface-lemma and independent-moment are saturated generically; request item 5 (Lean) is blocked by missing tooling and item 1 is covered by open PR 2193. This takes the explicit open follow-up of request item 2 (discussion comment 18934590): PR 2293 open next question 1, the MAS edge-form reading of Theorem B2 (iii).
bottleneck_link: A scoped audit of a submitted implication, not a bottleneck lever: it either strengthens Theorem B2 (iii) with a proof-backed statement or records the smallest counterexample, preventing an unsupported lemma from being carried into the rank-3 decoder chain that feeds the T = 3 open core (Q <= F2).
stop_rule: Stop at the first exact counterexample (report it smallest-first) or when the declared deterministic domain is exhausted; one bounded pivot maximum (pivot: switch the search to all-full-support cores after the mixed-support tier); no search beyond the declared domain.
evidence: Counterexample found and exactly confirmed: the MAS edge form of Theorem B2 (iii) is false. Smallest in the declared domain: v=5 all-full direction-class configuration (twin_q_v5#137, p/q data in README and verify.py output), 16 wild pairs, masE=8, edge RHS 8, exact minimum of cost(B) over all 2^16 admissible pairings = 6 (attained by a rank-2 unit-diagonal B, recomputed with the independent rank implementation). Second counterexample twin_q_v6#138: v=6, masE=11, edge RHS 11, exact minimum over 2^22 pairings = 9. The vertex form has no falsifier in 139 instances and the identity xbest = v - |H| - |F| + masV holds on all of them. Controls all pass; summary and digest frozen in RECEIPT.json (RECEIPT_MATCH). Propositions P1 (no complete zero-dot pairs at v >= 4 in Q^3) and P2 (edge form holds for all-full v <= 4) are proved in the README and machine-checked over the domain.

open_questions.question: What is the strongest rank-aware replacement for masE? The two counterexamples both come from duplicated q directions, where reciprocal wild pairs inflate masE while the block ranks of B pay once.
